prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Busan — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Busan as her world knows it — a harbour city of a myth-world on a deep blue bay: whitewashed stone and dark pine wood, gently upswept grey-tiled eaves, sailcloth, rope and polished ship's timber, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, camellia blossoms with softly glowing red petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the great bridge, the white tower, fireworks or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a festival street of lanterns, food stalls and paper decorations
Season: late summer, the typhoon season — hot, humid and rainy, with storms sweeping in from the sea.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Noelle from Genshin Impact — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a fitted strapless mini dress, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level; her shoulders, chest and hips turn away from the camera together, no twist at the waist; her chest stays turned away; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm reaches up, the hand on the shelf or line above her head — her near arm, on the image's right side toward the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the image's left side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it, and not the object she holds in it; only the costume's own pieces.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

사진 같은 마감이 붓결 지시보다 강함. 팔·손의 추가나 단절은 보이지 않음.
